tools.name: get_service_lines
tools.description: WildRun AI’s one service — managed SEO + AEO + GEO for businesses in Bend and Central Oregon — with its page, scope-and-pricing section, free audit request and contact page. Managed work is scoped and quoted after the free audit. Page URLs also answer 'Accept: text/markdown'.

tools.name: list_articles
tools.description: The archive of published articles, newest first: slug, title, description, topic cluster, date and URLs. Use this to find something to read before calling get_article.

tools.name: get_article
tools.description: The full text of one article as Markdown, by slug (get slugs from list_articles). Roughly a third of the bytes of the HTML page.

findings.title: Description issues instructions to the model
findings.detail: Description of "list_articles" contains imperative instructions directed at the AI assistant rather than describing the tool. This is the core tool-poisoning technique.

evidence.snippet: The archive of published articles, newest first: slug, title, description, topic cluster, date and URLs. Use this to find something to read before calling get_a…

findings.remediation: Treat the server as untrusted; the model may obey embedded instructions.
